enrichment.summary: The district is expanding an existing environmental services contract with Ninyo & Moore for the Fremont High School new construction project. The added work revises a cleanup plan and prepares completion and monitoring reports requested by the California Department of Toxic Substances Control. The change adds $206,391.00 for basic services plus $20,639.10 for additional services, $227,030.10 in all, raising the contract limit from $175,645.80 to $402,675.90.

enrichment.headline: Adds $52,388 and one year to Murakami/Nelson's design contract for Castlemont High field and bleachers
enrichment.summary: This amendment adds design work for the Castlemont High School Field & Bleachers Project, including a fee proposal to replace the scoreboard, drawings and specifications, and responses to state architect review comments. It adds $52,387.50 (including a $4,762.50 contingency), raising the contract limit from $1,044,900.00 to $1,097,287.50. It also extends the contract by 365 days, from December 31, 2022 to December 31, 2023.

enrichment.headline: Pays ACC Environmental up to $7,986 for soil testing before asphalt work at Kaiser Early Childhood center
enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will test soil for lead and arsenic, characterize soil waste, and provide data review, reports and consulting for the Kaiser Early Childhood Education Center Asphalt Replacement Project. The total limit is $7,986.00, which includes up to $726.00 for additional services. Work is scheduled from December 15, 2022 to March 31, 2023.

enrichment.headline: Pays Anthonio, Inc. up to $193,200 for inspection services to close out older construction projects
enrichment.summary: Anthonio, Inc. will provide inspector-of-record services needed for close-out documents on construction projects that require state review by the Division of the State Architect (DSA), as part of the DSA certification of a legacy project. The contract limit is $193,200.00. Work is scheduled from December 15, 2022 to December 31, 2023.

enrichment.headline: Extends Viatron Systems' 1000 Broadway digitalization contract to August 2023 at no added cost
enrichment.summary: This amendment gives Viatron Systems, Inc. more time on the Central Office 1000 Broadway Digitalization Project. The end date moves from December 26, 2022 to August 31, 2023, an additional 248 days. The text states no added money, and all other terms stay the same.

enrichment.headline: Pays HY Architects up to $381,150 to design roof, elevator and portable upgrades at Fremont High
enrichment.summary: Hibser Yamauchi (HY) Architects will provide architectural services for the Fremont High School Modernization Project. The work covers replacing roofing and an elevator, replacing the portable classrooms, and improving the Foothill Boulevard parking lot. The limit is $381,150.00 ($346,500.00 for basic services and $34,650.00 for additional services), with work from December 15, 2022 to December 31, 2024.
